meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared the reconciled Chat Completions role and tool-call handling with runtime and observability documentation. Campaign forms continue to use PHP validation and never invoke inference.

auth.review_note: Checked campaign CSRF, session-bound submission token and owner Inbox authorization against existing login/account policy, including guest and customer access checks.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the campaign additions against the order and catalogue contracts; campaign validation and owner CRM records do not enter commerce order, checkout or revenue processing.

content.review_note: Verified the campaign Contact and Inbox projection retains its submitted creation offset in JSON and binds that same instant as UTC in both SQL datetime columns.

foundation.review_note: Checked the portable UTC datetime bindings against the documented JSON storage and hosted database boundary. The database fixture still forces Inbox failure and asserts Contact rollback.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the updated Google reporting links, provider settings template and existing public head registration. The authored form and receipt render within the document body.

http-errors.review_note: Checked the native enquiry route failure handling against the HTTP response guard; unavailable writes are presented on-page and the campaign path logs a generic outcome.

interface.review_note: Compared updated analytics and integrations navigation with the authored reading column, mobile form layout, disabled preview and native receipt focus tests.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the merged AdminController and Inbox guide against the campaign Contact and Inbox projections. Accepting a campaign enquiry does not enqueue mail.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the merged Integrations page references against the MCP client guide and approved route inventory. Display-group changes are owner navigation and preserve the client capability and config instructions.

media.review_note: Reviewed the Owner UI skill and shared upload lock documentation against the media source. Campaign layout renders the same owned image before the enquiry form.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the campaign Inbox proof and mark-read flow against the owner guide. Saved JSON keeps the original date and offset shown on owner routes.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked that the merged ProjectMapService declares owner analytics and public authored enquiry separately from the fixed public MCP allowlist.

remote-commerce.review_note: Checked direct database timestamp bindings after normalization and preserved original JSON on the shared upsert and insert-if-absent paths used by remote commerce.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Verified merged developer instructions, generated route and service inventory, and the campaign HTTP and Chrome checks. The main workflow retains its independent analytics and agent coverage.
